verdict.rationale: Zapier documents connections to 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions through prebuilt integrations. App vendors build these integrations and publish them to the App Directory, then maintain them through the Partner Program and the version lifecycle. Community users confirm the breadth of the integration catalog. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of what share of directory integrations are vendor-maintained versus Zapier- or community-built, and independent hands-on corroboration of integration quality at the current scale.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: It lets your AI take real actions across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions, such as sending messages, creating tasks, and updating records
Build a Zapier integration - design triggers and actions for your product, wire up authentication, then publish to the App Directory.
